cellValuesByFieldId.fldHD0poWPmY0cEYS:
WR-002 — WHATSREPLY: AUTO RESPONSE LANGUAGE + CHAT ORDER LIKE WHATSAPP

Goal:
Make the working WhatsReply flow feel natural in daily use without changing the confirmed transport or current interaction model.

Owner feedback after testing:
1) Response language should be selected automatically from the incoming conversation.
2) The bubble-history screen should behave like WhatsApp: newest messages at the bottom, not the top.

A) Automatic response language
- The language of the outbound draft must default to the language of the incoming WhatsApp message / active conversation, NOT to the language in which the owner gives AI instructions.
- Example: incoming message is English, owner says in Russian “ответь, что мы заинтересованы” -> draft must be English.
- If incoming message is Thai -> draft Thai; Russian -> Russian, etc.
- For mixed-language or ambiguous short messages, use the dominant/recent conversation language for that contact/thread.
- If confidence is low and there is no usable thread history, preserve the language of the most recent substantive incoming message.
- REVISE must preserve the current draft/recipient language unless the owner explicitly asks to translate/change language.
- Explicit owner instruction (“ответь по-русски”, “write in English”) always overrides automatic detection.
- Do not translate names, addresses, project names, quoted text or technical terms unnecessarily.
- Keep the existing author-profile and COMPOSE/REVISE separation from WR-001.

B) Bubble history order
- Display conversation history chronologically: oldest at top, newest at bottom.
- Opening a chat should land at / scroll to the latest message by default.
- New incoming/sent/draft items should append at the bottom.
- Preserve normal scroll behavior when the user intentionally scrolls upward; do not aggressively jump to bottom while reading older messages unless a clear “new messages” behavior is used.
- Match WhatsApp mental model as closely as possible without visual overengineering.

C) Regression constraints
- Preserve confirmed notification capture and RemoteInput send path.
- Preserve incoming TTS, compose/revise behavior, male author profile, and existing local history.
- No Outliner/Airtable case-linking/backend expansion in this task.
